keywords.prompt:
Extract glossary lookup terms from the text for translation consistency.

Return ONLY a JSON array of strings with at most {max_terms} terms.

Rules:
1) Terms must be exact contiguous spans from the input text.
2) Prioritize proper nouns: names, places, factions, quests, items, spells, creatures, lore entities.
3) Fine-grained extraction: when a long proper-noun phrase appears, keep both the full phrase and its unique anchor token if present.
4) Do NOT infer, translate, normalize, or add synonyms.
5) Exclude generic/common words unless they are part of a proper noun span.
6) Keep original casing from the source text.
7) If no valid term exists, return [] only.

Text: "{text}"
